idea: Batched labeling prompt: 20 utterances/request, hand-written intent descriptions + decision rules + 20 seeds (deepseek-v4.1-flash)
change: custom batched labeler experiments/clinc150/blabel.py instead of label_examples (1 text/request)
takeaway: Batching 20/request cuts cost ~20x on a 3k-token 151-option prompt and descriptions+rules give 0.965 dev agreement (v1 ~0.90-0.93)

idea: Label the whole training pool with the batched prompt
change: 15,030 pool utterances labeled (752 requests), 0 missing; 291 labeled oos (1.9%), 52-291 per class
takeaway: Full pool (3x v1's data) for $0.15; this is the data lever

idea: LLM-generated out-of-scope utterances (16 near/far-domain topics x 6 styles), filtered by the labeler
change: 2,763 generated, 2,366 kept as oos by the labeler; 2,066 for training, 300 held out
takeaway: Cheap source of oos training data; the pool has only ~1.9% oos vs 18% on test

idea: A: gte-modernbert full FT on labeled pool only (lr 3e-5, 5 ep, max_len 64)
change: 13,818 pool labels (8% stratified silver-val held out)

dev.note: dev = 200 gold; ins/oos on dev+silver-val (1,412 texts, 31 real oos); near-miss = 250 held-out round-2 synthetic oos

takeaway: Baseline: strong in-scope (0.959) but weak oos recall, esp. near-miss oos

idea: B: A + 2,066 synthetic oos in training

dev.note: dev = 200 gold; ins/oos on dev+silver-val (1,412 texts, 31 real oos); near-miss = 250 held-out round-2 synthetic oos

takeaway: Synthetic oos lifts real oos recall 0.81->0.94 and near-miss 0.67->0.87 at ~-0.3pt in-scope

idea: C: B + real pool oos upweighted x3

dev.note: dev = 200 gold; ins/oos on dev+silver-val (1,412 texts, 31 real oos); near-miss = 250 held-out round-2 synthetic oos

takeaway: Upweighting the few labeled pool oos does not help once synthetic oos is present

idea: D: B + label smoothing 0.1

dev.note: dev = 200 gold; ins/oos on dev+silver-val (1,412 texts, 31 real oos); near-miss = 250 held-out round-2 synthetic oos

takeaway: Slightly more oos recall but lower in-scope accuracy; not adopted

idea: E: B with lr 5e-5, 4 epochs (seed 0)

dev.note: dev = 200 gold; ins/oos on dev+silver-val (1,412 texts, 31 real oos); near-miss = 250 held-out round-2 synthetic oos

takeaway: Higher LR recovers in-scope accuracy with synthetic oos; chosen recipe

idea: E seed 1 (seed-variance check)

dev.note: dev = 200 gold; ins/oos on dev+silver-val (1,412 texts, 31 real oos); near-miss = 250 held-out round-2 synthetic oos

takeaway: Seed noise in oos recall is ~2 of 31 examples; tau 0.4 best for both seeds; kept seed 0

idea: Round-2 near-miss synthetic oos: per CLINC domain, shown that domain's intents, plus far topics
change: 1,832 generated, 1,129 kept as oos by the labeler (250 held out as near-miss eval set)
takeaway: Useful as a hard held-out oos estimate; 38% were relabeled in-scope, showing near misses are often truly in scope

idea: F: E + 879 round-2 near-miss synthetic oos in training

dev.note: dev = 200 gold; ins/oos on dev+silver-val (1,412 texts, 31 real oos); near-miss = 250 held-out round-2 synthetic oos

takeaway: Near-miss oos training costs ~0.8pt in-scope accuracy (some near misses are in scope); net worse at an 18% oos prior

idea: oos confidence threshold: predict oos if max in-scope prob < tau
change: tau grid 0-0.8 on dev+silver-val+near-miss, objective 0.82*in-scope + 0.18*oos recall (public 18% test oos share); chose tau=0.4
takeaway: A mild threshold trades ~0.1pt in-scope for 3-5pt near-miss oos recall

idea: Full dynamic int8 (all MatMul/Gemm, per-channel) on gte-modernbert
takeaway: Fast but loses ~1pt in-scope accuracy on this 151-way task

idea: fp32 ONNX (no quantisation)
takeaway: Passes on a quiet machine but p95 65-99 ms under shared load: too close to the 70 ms gate

idea: Partial int8 (no_mlpWo): mlp.Wo + head kept fp32
takeaway: Nearly lossless and fastest partial variant

idea: Partial int8 (only_Wi): only mlp.Wi quantised
takeaway: Identical predictions to fp32 with p95 ~24-27 ms; chosen

idea: Partial int8 (only_Wi_Wqkv): mlp.Wi + attn.Wqkv quantised
takeaway: Nearly lossless

idea: Partial int8 (skip_first_last2): layers 0,1,20,21 + head kept fp32
takeaway: Keeping edge layers fp32 does not fix it; mlp.Wo is the sensitive matrix

idea: Final pipeline latency (partial int8 only_Wi, ONNX Runtime, 4 threads, batch 1)
takeaway: Well under the 70 ms gate

idea: post-hoc calibration
change: none chosen (candidates none/temperature; 151 classes x 200 dev)
takeaway: Temperature not better than none on dev CV (seed-unstable); vector changes argmax, isotonic degenerate. Test ECE ours 0.121 (oos-rule rows sit at conf ~0.28) vs Jev 0.024.

idea: batch-1 serving consistency
change: test/dev predictions recomputed at batch size 1; calibrator refit on b1 dev -> none
takeaway: 14/5500 deployed decision flips (11 involve oos); accuracy 0.9338 vs 0.9340 batched; still beats Jev 0.895.
